# What does it contain and what time period does it cover? 

This dataset contains all of Taylor Swift's songs that come from an album that she released, and it covers October 2006 - October 2025. I'm debating whether to use this one or taylor_all_songs, because with the album songs, she has more control over the actual emotion of the song, but with the all songs, she still does have some impact on how the song is emotionally just not as much.

# Which columns will be most important for your analysis? 

The valence and track_release column.
